Launch BF: Trainy (S23) — OSS experiment tracking for teams displaced by Neptune.ai’s shutdown
TLDR: Neptune is shutting down in March. We built Pluto so AI teams can migrate their experiment tracking safely and with ease. Since side-by-side comparisons with Neptune are valuable to us, we’ll give any YC company that signs up in the next week (or next 2 days) a ___ discount (maybe 1 month free hosted, or just 50% off until neptune’s shutdown?).
Hey Bookface, we’re Roanak & Andrew, founders of Trainy. We build GPU scheduling & management software for AI teams running large clusters.
Neptune’s shutdown in March is creating a migration fire drill for a lot of AI teams. Nearly all of our customers are in that boat, so we shipped Pluto: a maintained fork of the mlop experiment tracking repo.  We’ve focused a lot of our work on increasing the performance and reliability of the log/metrics shipper during multi-node/gpu usage as well as a better user experience around searching/filtering runs via tags.  
Docs: https://trainy.mintlify.app/pluto/overview
Github: https://github.com/Trainy-ai/pluto
Quickstart: https://trainy.mintlify.app/pluto/quickstart
Why You Should Try Pluto:
We’ve enabled dual-logging to Neptune and Pluto simultaneously, so teams can migrate gradually without disrupting workflows. Teams can validate Pluto against real prod usage before committing to a cutover.
import pluto.compat.neptune # Add this line
import neptune # Your existing Neptune import
# Your existing Neptune code works unchanged
run = neptune.init_run(project="my-workspace/my-project")
run["parameters"] = {"lr": 0.001, "batch_size": 32}
run["train/loss"].log(0.5)
run.stop()
AI teams can self-host Pluto, making it suitable for orgs working with sensitive data in restricted environments. We will also offer a hosted solution, free for active Trainy customers or $250/seat/month. Our goal is to support Pluto as a long-term experiment tracking option for teams post-Neptune.
From talking to our users, we’ve consistently heard people love Neptune for its scalability and responsiveness of the UI. Pluto is being built for researchers that are constantly jumping between runs, comparing metrics, and inspecting results throughout the day.
How to Try Pluto:
The fastest (& safest) way to get started is following the quickstart (link) and using our Neptune compatibility layer for dual logging.
If you want to try the hosted version, reach out to us directly once you’ve made an account on pluto.trainy.ai. We’re onboarding teams manually for now and can help get permissions set up quickly while we finish self-serve.
Asks:
If you’re a Neptune power user, try running Pluto with dual logging before the shutdown in March. We’re especially interested in feedback from people running Pluto and Neptune side-by-side: any gaps you notice, mismatches that would block a cutover, or places where the UI feels meaningfully slower or different. Feel free to share thoughts in the comments or email roanak@trainy.ai.
Drop us a star on github! https://github.com/Trainy-ai/pluto
